name: Kumon (centres islandwide)
summary: Structured maths and reading centres — one enrichment option among many; trial commute and culture before locking in.
body: Method franchises like Kumon suit some children and frustrate others. Singapore parents often stack enrichment aggressively in year two; arrival-year guidance on expat.sg is to prioritise one social and one physical activity before method centres. Trial the specific centre near you — instructor culture and travel time matter more than brand. Exit guilt-free after a month if it is a poor fit. Compare against ActiveSG programmes and school CCA before assuming paid enrichment is mandatory. Enrichment is not licensed childcare — if both parents work full days, model ECDA infant/childcare hours separately from Kumon worksheets, and do not use tuition centres as after-care without written centre policy.
